workflow.name: AI Hotel Receptionist via WhatsApp
workflow.description: WhatsApp-based AI hotel receptionist: validates incoming messages, uses Redis to load-balance GPT model selection, runs a GPT agent with SQL (MySQL) and pricing (Google Sheets) tools, and replies to guests via WhatsApp.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: API key for OpenAI GPT used as the hotel AI agent

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible API endpoint

MODEL.description: LLM model name for the hotel agent

REDIS_URL.description: Redis connection URL for model assignment (mocked in-memory)

MYSQL_HOST.description: MySQL host for hotel database (mocked with SQLite in-memory)

workflow_steps.name: WhatsApp Trigger
workflow_steps.description: Receive a WhatsApp message from a hotel guest

workflow_steps.name: Check Message
workflow_steps.description: Validate the webhook event is a text message; exit early if not

workflow_steps.name: Check User Number
workflow_steps.description: Redis GET: look up which model index was last assigned to this WhatsApp user

workflow_steps.name: Model Decider
workflow_steps.description: Alternate model index: 0→1 or 1→0; default 0 if no prior record
